turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: For about six months I’ve had persistent fatigue and I’ve lost around 5 kilograms without trying, though my appetite has stayed good. I wanted to check whether something might be wrong.
Have you experienced any fevers, night sweats, or episodes of sweating that seem excessive or occur particularly at night?
I haven’t had fevers or night sweats, and I don’t notice any excessive sweating at night. I’ve also not had any recent infections.
Have you noticed any changes in your tolerance to heat, trembling of your hands, or a sensation of your heart racing or beating irregularly?
I haven’t noticed any change in heat tolerance, trembling of my hands, or a sensation of my heart racing or beating irregularly.
Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits,
“No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my bowel habits—no new diarrhea, constipation, or blood that I can see.” “I’m also not having any urinary changes or trouble with bleeding.”
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually thirsty or needing to urinate more frequently than usual, especially at night?
Patient: No, I haven’t been unusually thirsty and I haven’t needed to urinate more often, including at night. I’m not having any urinary symptoms or changes that I’ve noticed.
Have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin, or any new masses anywhere on your body?
“No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or swelling in my neck, armpits, or groin, and I haven’t felt any new masses anywhere on my body.”
Have you had any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or chest discomfort, even if mild?

Patient: No, I haven’t had any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or chest discomfort. I’ve mainly just been dealing with the fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the past six months.
Have you noticed any persistent feelings of sadness, loss of interest in activities you used to enjoy, or changes in your sleep patterns?
“No, I haven’t felt persistently sad or lost interest in my usual activities, and my sleep hasn’t changed noticeably. It’s mainly just the ongoing fatigue and the unintentional weight loss.”
Have you experienced any abdominal pain, discomfort, bloating, or a sensation of feeling full very quickly after starting to eat?

“No, I haven’t had any abdominal pain, bloating, or discomfort, and I don’t feel full very quickly when I start eating. I’ve just noticed the fatigue and the unintentional weight loss over the last six months.”
Have you noticed your stools being particularly pale, floating, difficult to flush, or unusually foul-smelling?
Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any pale or floating stools, and they haven’t been unusually foul-smelling or difficult to flush.
How old are you, and what is your gender?
I’m 72 years old, and I’m a male.
Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or any persistent itching without a rash?
“No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or eyes, and I don’t have persistent itching or a rash.”
Have you ever smoked, and if so, how many pack-years? Also, have you noticed any blood in your stool or black, tarry stools?
“No, I’ve never smoked, so I don’t have any pack-years. And I haven’t noticed any blood in my stool or black, tarry stools.”
Have you had any persistent bone pain, particularly in your back, hips, or ribs, or have you suffered any fractures from minor injuries?

“No, I haven’t had persistent bone pain in my back, hips, or ribs, and I haven’t had any fractures from minor injuries. My main issues have been fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the past six months.”
Have you noticed any stiffness or pain in your shoulders or hips, particularly in the morning, or any new headaches, pain in your jaw when chewing, or any vision changes?
Patient: No, I haven’t had any stiffness or pain in my shoulders or hips in the morning, and I haven’t noticed any new headaches or jaw pain when chewing. I also haven’t had any vision changes.
